_doc: AP-C (#48): runtime flags the chapters cite that the DSL artifacts do not name. Each entry is checked against the source at the release given. tools/gen-appendices.py renders them into Appendix C and fails if a chapter cites a NOETL_*/WORKER_*/GATEWAY_* variable that is in neither table. Names ending in '_' in prose are patterns (e.g. NOETL_MCP_<SLUG>_ENDPOINT) and are not checked.

bearer for internal routes; the gateway's push ingress is refused without it
